messages:
elaine: heads-up, APAC GPU pools showing sustained high queues and we're seeing lots of fast retries from a mobile client fleet. 429s climbing past expected baselines
marco: confirmed in PoolWatch. node utilization ~91% and queue dwell time median -> 420ms, 95p -> 2.1s. a few long-running gen jobs are pinning capacity
ops-bot: autoscaler: no new GPUs available in apac-zone-b for 30m; provisioning ETA 2h
elaine: we need a short-term client-facing mitigation. can runtime emit something more informative than Retry-After so SDKs back off politely?
sdk-lead: yes, SDKs can respect more detailed hints. minimal and stable surface would be ideal. too many fields means fragile parsing on mobile
kev: propose a compact set: `X-RW-ADMIT-WAIT-MS` (numeric), `X-RW-ADMIT-HEADROOM` (0..1 fraction), and keep `Retry-After` for older clients. headroom=0 means full, 1 means free capacity
marco: runtime can compute headroom = clamp(1 - (queue_depth / effective_capacity), 0, 1). we'll smooth it over 30s to avoid jitter
elaine: what about signaling that clients should reduce concurrency rather than just delay? a hint like `X-RW-CONC-SUGGEST: -30%` would be helpful
sdk-lead: SDKs can honor `X-RW-CONC-SUGGEST` but only if it's a simple signed percent. we'll ignore complex tokens. maintain default behavior if absent
marco: implementation notes: we will emit headers with clamping: wait_ms between 50 and 6000, headroom rounded to 2 decimals, conc-suggest in whole percent steps. also include `X-RW-POOL-ID` for observability
kev: to prevent retry storms we'll add a transient multiplier if pool.retry_rate_1m > threshold: multiply wait_ms by 1.6 and reduce headroom by 0.12. this damping persists for 60s
ops-bot: rollout plan: flag `rw.admit.hints_compact=true` in staging. will enable for 3% prod traffic as a canary after staging bake
sdk-lead: SDK pseudocode (for mobile):
```
// on 429
wait = header.get("X-RW-ADMIT-WAIT-MS") || (header.get("Retry-After")*1000) || 250
headroom = parseFloat(header.get("X-RW-ADMIT-HEADROOM")) || 0
concAdj = parseInt(header.get("X-RW-CONC-SUGGEST")) || 0
jitter = uniform(0.7, 1.2)
delay = clamp(wait * jitter * (1 << attempt), 75, 20000)
applyConcurrencyMultiplier(1 + concAdj/100, duration=20s)
sleep(delay)
```
elaine: agree on max attempts: generations max 3, embeddings max 2. SDK should emit aggregated telemetry for headroom hist (opt-in) so we can correlate UX with capacity signals
marco: ops will add dashboard panels: admit.wait_ms distribution, headroom over time, pool.retry_rate, and client-side retry reduction metric
kev: small caution: if wait estimates are consistently too low, clients may spin. runtime will bias estimates upward when damping triggers and we'll monitor oscillation score
sdk-lead: we'll ship SDK change behind a feature flag and coordinate mobile teams. will add fallback parsing tests for malformed headers
elaine: target canary tonight at 23:15 UTC for 5% APAC traffic. post-canary we'll decide to widen or rollback
marco: PRs: runtime header emission -> open, ops canary route -> in progress, sdk patch -> in-review. I'll paste links here when ready
sdk-lead: will update CHANGELOG and add short doc snippet under "Client backpressure hints"
ops-bot: reminder: create follow-up incident if post-canary retry-rate increases by >15%
elaine: thanks all. keep this thread updated with PR links and canary results :thumbsup:
